meta_description:
1,520 likes, 378 comments - aliabdaal on October 6, 2026: "Comment ‘BIZZ’ for my top 38 business books recommendations list 📚

This book helped me become financially free. It's called The Simple Path to Wealth by JL Collins.

I read this book 10 years ago when I first started investing back in 2015 and it taught me everything you need to know about investing. There's a bunch of stuff that's specific to the US, so if you're not in the US you can kind of ignore those bits. I was in the UK at the time and ignored those bits.

Thanks to this book, I've been investing consistently with all of the spare cash I've earned from my businesses over the last 10 years. And that has compounded to a point where I do feel broadly financially free.

If you're interested in learning how to invest properly and like the theory and the philosophy and the math behind it, you should totally check it out.

Comment ‘BIZZ’ for my top 38 business books recommendations list 📚".
